label: sec:jet-prolongation-intro
html:
This chapter extends the quantum observable universe (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) into a recursive hierarchy. Each level A_n of this tower forms the jet prolongation of the previous one. The subsequent mechanisms of lifting, descent, and mass decomposition rely strictly on this tower. This section formally constructs it.

One first establishes that the tangent algebra T(A) = \mathrm{Sym}_A(\Omega^1_{A/R}), whose degree-\le 1 part is the jet object J^1(A), carries a Hopf structure and fibre functor for which A \to T(A) \to A are Hopf maps. No Frobenius form is required at the levels above A. Iterating this procedure algebraically generates the recursive brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0}. One then examines the smooth geometric model J^1\mathcal{S}_n and defines the arc space \mathcal{L}(X), which rigorously assembles the levels into a single ind-scheme. This tower provides the formal carrier for defining torsion and transport.
